about.body1: augo was founded by Fabi and Bruna, two endurance coaches who also happened to work in tech. As a business analyst and data scientist, they expected their tools to help them coach better.
about.highlight1: Instead, they found themselves drowning in fragmented communication, losing important details, and missing the signals that mattered.
about.body2: So they built augo. Because coaching is hard enough without tools that create more work. We believe AI should support human expertise with the right insights at the right time, helping you do what you do best: understand and develop your athletes.
about.highlight2: Technology that serves coaches, not the other way around
about.body3: In late 2025, Andreas Hermann, a computer scientist and triathlete joined augo as a co-founder. He not only brings in experience as a CTO in a sportstech company but also worked on the same problem as augo did before the three founder met.
about.highlight3: They decided to join forces and Andreas joined augo's mission.

items.question: How much does augo cost?

items.question: Will augo replace coaches?
items.answer: No. augo is designed to empower coaches, not replace them. It automates repetitive tasks and surfaces actionable insights so coaches can focus on strategy, relationships, and what they do best.

items.question: Can athletes use augo without a coach?
items.answer: No. The experience is designed for athletes working with a coach. Self-coached athletes need to create both a coach account and an athlete account, and connect them to each other.

items.question: Why choose augo over AI coaching apps?
items.answer: Unlike standalone AI coaching apps, augo keeps the human coach at the center. It combines the power of AI analysis with human expertise, context, and the personal connection that drives athlete success.

items.question: How does augo handle my data?
items.answer: Your data privacy and security are our top priorities. augo uses industry-standard encryption and never shares your personal data with third parties. You remain in full control of your information.

items.question: How do I find the right endurance coach online?
items.answer: Start with your sport and goal — running, cycling or triathlon — then your experience, schedule and the communication style you want. On augo you can search the coach directory in plain English (for example, 'a marathon coach for a busy parent') or chat with augo and we'll email you the closest matches from our roster.

items.question: Do augo coaches coach remotely or online?
items.answer: Yes. Most augo coaches work with athletes online, anywhere in the world — delivering training plans, feedback and day-to-day communication through the app. Some also coach in person locally. Each coach's profile shows whether they coach remotely and which languages they speak.

items.question: How much does an online running, cycling or triathlon coach cost?
items.answer: It varies by coach, experience and how hands-on the support is. Many endurance coaches charge a monthly fee, and typical starting prices are listed on individual coach profiles. augo connects you directly with the coach so you can agree on what's included before you commit.

items.question: Can I get a coach for my first marathon or first IRONMAN?
items.answer: Absolutely. augo coaches work with everyone from complete beginners to elite athletes. Whether it's your first marathon, your first IRONMAN 70.3 or a goal personal best, you can filter the roster by discipline and specialty to find a coach who has guided athletes through exactly that.

items.question: What should I look for in a good endurance coach?
items.answer: Look for real experience in your discipline and event, a communication style that suits you, and a coaching philosophy you believe in. The best coaches combine training data with how you actually feel, adapt the plan to real life, and stay responsive. Every augo profile lists specialties, credentials, languages and experience so you can compare.

items.question: How does augo match me with a coach?
items.answer: Tell augo about your sport, goals, experience, schedule and what matters most to you in a coach. augo searches the roster across discipline, specialty, location and language, then surfaces your best-fit matches and introduces you over email so you can take it from there.

hero.title: Connect augo to Claude and ChatGPT
hero.lead: augo runs an MCP server. Add it as a connector and you can ask Claude or ChatGPT about your athletes — their workouts, how they're feeling, and what you've talked about. You can also ask them to create workouts, build reports and process sessions. The sky is the limit.
hero.lastVerified: Last checked against Claude and ChatGPT on 4 September 2026.

items.label: Who it's for
items.statement: Coaches with an augo account.

items.label: What you need
items.statement: Claude or ChatGPT, and your augo email and password.

items.label: Setup time
items.statement: About two minutes per app.

items.label: Cost
items.statement: Included in augo Pro. Coaches also have access during the free trial.

items.label: What augo can see and do

steps.title: Open your settings
steps.body: In Claude, click your profile, then Settings.

steps.title: Add a custom connector
steps.body: Go to Connectors and click Add custom connector.
steps.note: On some plans this sits under Customize rather than Settings. On a Team or Enterprise workspace an owner has to add the connector once under Organization settings, after which it appears here for everyone to connect.

steps.title: Point it at augo and sign in
steps.body: Name the connector augo, paste the augo MCP server URL below, and click Add. Claude then asks you to sign in — use your augo coach email and password.
steps.note: Leave the sign-in window open until it closes on its own. Closing it early leaves the connector half-added.

chatgpt.title: Connect augo to ChatGPT
chatgpt.lead: Four steps. Developer mode has to be on first.
chatgpt.callout: A custom connector can only be added from ChatGPT in a desktop browser. Once it is added you can use augo from the ChatGPT mobile app as normal.

steps.title: Open your settings
steps.body: In ChatGPT in a desktop browser, click your profile, then Settings.

steps.title: Turn on developer mode
steps.body: Open Connectors, then Advanced. Find Developer mode and switch it on.
steps.note: ChatGPT flags this as an elevated-risk setting. That warning covers every custom connector, not augo in particular — it is there because a connector can read your data and act on it.

steps.title: Create a new connector
steps.body: Go back to Settings, then Connectors, and click the plus button to create one.

steps.title: Name it and sign in
steps.body: Name it augo, paste the augo MCP server URL below, and click Create. Then sign in with your augo coach email and password.

prompts.title: What you can ask once you're connected
prompts.lead: Ask in your own words. These are starting points, not commands — nothing has to be phrased a particular way.

groups.label: Who needs attention
items: Which of my athletes needs attention today?
Show me anyone whose feedback has trended down over the last two weeks.
Summarise my coaching priorities for this morning.

groups.label: Training load and sessions
items: What was Anna's training load last week compared with the four weeks before?
Which sessions did Marco miss this month, and what did he say about them?
Pull up the details of Sofia's long run yesterday.

groups.label: Feedback and wellbeing
items: How have Lena's energy and sleep scores moved since her last race block?
Which athletes have flagged pain in the last ten days?

groups.label: Messages
items: What did Tom message me about this week that I haven't answered?
Draft a reply to Julia about moving her Thursday session to Friday.

groups.label: Calendar and races
items: Which of my athletes are racing in the next eight weeks?
Add a note to next Tuesday: the group session moves to the track.

groups.label: Zones, anchors and templates
items: What are Peter's current run zones, and when were they last updated?
Record a new threshold anchor for Anna from Saturday's test.
Assign my Aerobic 90 template to Marco for Sunday.

access.title: What augo can see, and what it can do

items.label: Your athletes only
items.statement: The connector signs in as you. It sees exactly what you see in augo — your athletes, your messages, your notes. Nothing else, and nothing belonging to another coach.

items.label: It can act, not just read
items.statement: As well as reading, it can send messages to your athletes, assign and edit workouts, and write notes, race events and performance anchors. Claude and ChatGPT ask you to confirm before an action of that kind.

items.label: Data leaves augo
items.statement: Whatever the assistant reads is sent to Anthropic or OpenAI to answer your question, under their terms and their data retention. If that is not acceptable for your athletes' data, do not connect.

items.label: Disconnect any time
items.statement: Remove the augo connector in Claude or ChatGPT settings. Access stops immediately and nothing changes in your augo account.

items.question: I can't find “Add custom connector” in Claude.
items.answer: It sits under Settings or Customize, depending on your plan. If it is missing entirely you are either on a plan that does not allow custom connectors, or you are in a Team or Enterprise workspace where an owner has to add it once for everyone first.

items.question: Can I set this up on my phone?
items.answer: Not for ChatGPT — the connector has to be added from a desktop browser. Once it is added you can use it from the mobile app. Claude can be set up on desktop or web.

items.question: Do I need a paid Claude or ChatGPT plan?
items.answer: Claude allows custom connectors on its free plan with a limit on how many you can have; paid plans lift that. ChatGPT requires developer mode, which is not available on the free plan. Check the current terms with Anthropic or OpenAI — both change these often.

items.question: The sign-in window closed and nothing happened.
items.answer: Remove the connector and add it again, and this time let the sign-in window close by itself. If it still fails, sign in to augo in the same browser first, then retry.

items.question: Claude or ChatGPT says it can't find any augo tools.
items.answer: The connector was added but not authorised. Open it in your connector settings and check it shows as connected; if it does not, disconnect and sign in again.

items.question: Can my athletes connect augo to Claude or ChatGPT?
items.answer: No. The connector is for coach accounts.

items.question: How do I disconnect augo?
items.answer: Remove the augo connector in Claude or ChatGPT settings. Access stops straight away. Your augo account, athletes and data are unaffected.

items.question: I already have a connector called augo.
items.answer: Names have to be unique, so remove the old one before adding a new one, or give the new one a different name. The name is only a label — what matters is the server URL.

cta.title: Not on augo yet?
cta.lead: The connector is for coaches with an augo account. Start there.
